preseason_view.minutes_gap: Minutes per player in pre-season friendlies are not published. Checked 2026-07-31: fbref (Cloudflare challenge), understat, sofascore, worldfootball, transfermarkt and 11v11 all block automated access - five of them name AI agents explicitly - and football-data.org puts Club Friendlies behind a paid tier. Spoofing a browser identity to get around that is not acceptable, so this column is absent rather than empty.

squads.label: Balanced
squads.rationale: Straight projected points. No thumb on the scale.

squads.label: Value
squads.rationale: Projected points per million. Spreads budget, strong bench.

squads.label: Even spread
squads.rationale: Caps player price so no single slot eats the budget.

squads.label: Low risk
squads.rationale: Punishes rotation risk and new-club uncertainty.

squads.label: Differential
squads.rationale: Rewards low ownership among players with real projections.

squads.label: Fixture-led
squads.rationale: Leans harder on the next few opponents.

caveats: Pre-season: these are last season's rates against this season's fixtures.
Rows marked NEW changed club this summer. Their stats were earned at their OLD club but are shown against their NEW club's fixtures - new role, new system, unknown minutes.
Newly promoted players and summer signings from abroad have no data and are absent.
Backtest found ~+0.3 to +0.5 correlation for ANY predictor, and xGI did not reliably beat last season's points. This is a shortlist, not a forecast.
Mid-season signings are understated: minutes spread over 38 games they were not all available for. Check st% before trusting a low number.
